summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Solaris Energy Infrastructure, LLC issued $1.25 billion of 7.000% senior notes due 2032 in a Rule 144A/Reg S private placement. Notes priced at par, yielding about $1,227.2 million net of purchaser discount and expenses, mature April 1, 2032, with interest payable each April 1 and October 1 beginning April 1, 2027. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and growth capex. Guaranteed unsecured by the parent and subsidiary guarantors, structurally senior to convertible notes. Watch leverage and capex deployment, not deal arbitrage.
